item.title: Lazarus Exploits Windows Zero-Day to Gain SYSTEM Access and Deploy Backdoor
item.summary: The North Korean threat actor known as Lazarus Group has been attributed to the zero-day exploitation of a newly patched security flaw impacting Microsoft Windows to deliver a never-before-seen backdoor targeting defense and aerospace companies across France, Germany, Brazil, and India.
